_comment: KRAKEN: an 11th top-level menu category whose sub-list hosts this project's screens.
Splice sites, expected bytes and table contents are Snake's (dm32uv-re tools/examples/snake/snake.patch.json,
docs/menu-system.md 'Adding an 11th category'); only the handlers and the placement differ.
This patch and Snake are mutually exclusive: they edit the same eleven sites.
name: kraken_ui
description: KRAKEN top-level menu category with a sub-list of patch screens (About, RSSI meter, ...).

data.name: krk_vox_kids_zh
data.why: stock VOX child list, zh (descriptor 0x030b82b8 lang 0: VOX SW, Gain Level) + child 2 = stock's own VOX Delay string (Other Func zh array slot 4). The stock arrays are packed against their neighbours and the descriptor. The level-5 installer 0x030449ec and the level-6 header 0x03038b9e both follow the descriptor's count and pointer, so the third row and its title are data only

data.name: krk_vox_kids_en
data.why: stock VOX child list, en (VOX SW, Gain Level) + child 2 = stock's VOX Delay string (Other Func en array slot 4)

data.name: krk_of_lbl_cwid
data.why: label of Other Func item 11 (2026-11-05, docs/cw-id.md, docs/otherfunc-submenu.md). Stock never lists item 10 (Lone Worker) or 11 (Man Down): the generator skips them and their slots in both per-item tables are the no-op exits, so the Man Down slot is reused as the CW ID parent row with no table relocation. The level-5 header 0x03038994 reads 0x030b8708[lang].ptr[item], so the label also titles the child list

data.name: krk_cs_arr_zh
data.why: stock Channel Set zh strings (descriptor 0x030b89a0 lang 0, 22 rows Rx Frequency..APRS Receive) + items 22..30 (DMR Link, Burst Voice, Scrambler On/Off, Key, Parrot On/Off, Replay Audio, Check, Clear Audio, Status). The two stock arrays abut each other and the descriptor (zh+88 = en, en+88 = the descriptor), so neither can grow in place: both are relocated. 2026-11-03: the four relocated tables abutted one another at their old addresses, so they were MOVED here

data.name: krk_cs_arr_en
data.why: stock Channel Set en strings (descriptor lang 1), same layout as zh: 22 stock + 9 of ours. 2026-11-03: the four relocated tables abutted one another at their old addresses, so they were MOVED here

data.name: krk_cs_itemjmp
data.why: Channel Set ENTER jump table (OK on the row, event 0x1b): 22 stock case blocks of table_entry_select_and_index_list_build_toplevel_dispatch @0x03047324 + 9 stub entries (items 22..30). The stock table 0x030b0a18 is packed directly before 0x030b0a70 so it must be relocated; its only reference is the literal-pool word at 0x03047370. 2026-11-03: the four relocated tables abutted one another at their old addresses, so they were MOVED here

data.name: krk_cs_okjmp
data.why: Channel Set COMMIT jump table (OK INSIDE a row's option level, event 0x22): 22 stock case blocks of 0x0304dc8c + 9 stub entries (items 22..30). MEASURED 2026-11-03: the committing OK runs 0x0303a57c -> bsr 0x0304e560 -> jump table 0x030b11c4[1] = 0x0304e5aa -> bsr 0x0304dc8c, which re-reads the level-3 row and dispatches it through THIS table - unlike Radio Settings (0x030b11c4[0] = a pure no-op), so the row never has to be latched. The stock table 0x030b116c is immediately followed by 0x030b11c4 so it must be relocated; its only reference is the literal-pool word at 0x0304dcc0. 2026-11-03: the four relocated tables abutted one another at their old addresses, so they were MOVED here

splices.name: menu_append_hook
splices.why: menu_option_gen_idx23 after its last stock append: `st16.h r3,(r4,0); br16 0x0304a112` (count store, then the shared tail) -> bsr krk_menu_append, which redoes the store, appends category index 10 and jumps to the tail itself. These 4 bytes exist in every supported build; the padding halfword 048 has after the br16 does not (DM32.01.L01.048 puts a literal word there). Nothing branches to the br16

splices.name: menu_append_hook24
splices.why: idx24 (VFO-mode top list): `lrw r2,[0x3049fec]; ld.b r2,(r2,0)` -> bsr stub that appends index 10 then re-executes both (krk_stubs.S)

splices.name: txtrim_interp
splices.why: F6: freq_calibration_apply_all's bsr freq_calibration_interpolate_selected, whose r0 is stored as the PA drive byte (st.b r0,(r5,0x28) next). Wrapper calls it and scales r0; caller uses only r4/r5 after; r15 saved by the prologue.

splices.name: aprs_bearing_hemisphere
splices.why: Stock APRS popup bearing/distance ignore N/S/E/W: stub rewrites W/S stack doubles to 360-x before calc/distance (docs/aprs-stock-gaps.md B.6). Displaced `ld.w r2,(sp,0x18); st.w r2,(sp,0)` re-executed in the stub; r15 saved by the caller's push.

splices.name: lh_call_start
splices.why: F1: rxvoice_task_entry flag-0x2 block (every accepted voice header). bsr to a no-arg byte read; the caller uses only r0 after it (docs/last-heard-hooks.md).

splices.name: lh_call_end
splices.why: F1: same task, flag-0x4 block: bsr modem_control_state_stop (void(void)); after it only r4/r5/r9 (callee-saved) and fresh r0/r1.

splices.name: lh_alias
splices.why: F1: event_flags9_dispatch_and_name_encode copies the decoded talker alias with memcpy_bytes_iram(dst, src, 0x20); only r4 (callee-saved) is used after.

splices.name: aprs_render_hook
splices.why: render case block of APRS (category 9) in menu_screen_render_entry_variant: `lrw r3,[settings]; ld.b r2,(r3,0x30)` -> bsr krk_aprs_render (installs count/ptr/subtype and the per-mode index list; r0-r3/r12 dead here, r4-r6/r15 saved by the prologue), then aprs_render_tail jumps over the rest of the block to the shared tail 0x0303dd78

splices.name: aprs_render_tail
splices.why: br16 0x0303dd78 (imm10 = (0x0303dd78-0x0303dd44)/2 = 0x1a) over the dead remainder of the block

splices.name: aprs_desc_zh_ptr
splices.why: APRS sub-list descriptor (category 9), docs/aprs-submenu.md

splices.name: aprs_item_bound
splices.why: cmphsi r2,8 -> cmphsi r2,16 (raw imm = value-1): items 8..15 are ours

splices.name: aprs_item_table_ptr
splices.why: pool word loaded by the lrw at 0x0303d55a

splices.name: aprs_mode_hook
splices.why: channel_change_apply_dispatcher: `cmpnei r3,0x30` of the DMR-only test that sets [0x40078] bit 0 (APRS active on this channel) -> bsr stub that re-executes it and also accepts nibble 0 (analog FM), leaving the stock `bt clear` at 0x03057aac to act on C (krk_stubs.S krk_hook_aprs_mode)

splices.name: aprs_tick_hook
splices.why: ui_periodic_maintenance_task_loop: start of the GPS-fix-or-fixed-position gate (`lrw r2,[0x38c6c]; ld.b r2,(r2,0)`) before `bsr 0x030625bc` (APRS periodic tick) -> bsr krk_hook_aprs_tick, which applies that gate and calls the stock tick on digital channels and runs the AFSK beacon on analog ones; r0-r3 dead here, r15 saved by the prologue

splices.name: aprs_tick_tail
splices.why: br16 0x030548a4 (imm10 = (0x030548a4-0x0305488c)/2 = 0x0c) over the rest of the displaced gate and the stock tick call, then nop16 (mov r0,r0) filler

splices.name: aprs_send_now_hook
splices.why: manual Upload Beacon (programmable key path 0x03015824): bsr 0x03062510 (stock DMR APRS send, void(void)) -> krk_hook_aprs_send_now: AFSK on an analog channel, the stock send on a digital one; nothing live after it (pop follows)

splices.name: chan_commit_end_hook
splices.why: commit_channel_record_dual_vfo @0x030303bc, the single writer of the live channel struct 0x3e1dc (it also stores a per-side copy at 0x3e358 / 0x3e21c, choosing the side by `get_current_mode_state2() == 0 ? selected : loaded`): all of its paths end at the shared epilogue `ld.w r15,(sp,0); addi sp,sp,0x14; rts`. The 4-byte `ld.w r15,(sp,0)` -> bsr krk_commit_end_stub, which runs krk_hook_chan_commit (snapshot of rx/tx/flags8 per side + the side the struct now describes, docs/dual-watch.md) and re-executes the load. r0-r3/r12/r13 are dead at the epilogue; r15 is restored by the stub

splices.name: maint_tick_hook
splices.why: ui_periodic_maintenance_task_loop: `bsr 0x03068224` (call_hold_led_debounce_dual_timer_tick, void(void); r0-r3 dead after it) -> krk_hook_maint_tick, which makes the stock call first and then runs the feature ticks (krk_periodic.c: F12 scrambler, F10 Doppler)

splices.name: bg_tick_hook
splices.why: F14 RX Monitor. main_ui_background_task_loop (task init, prio 30, one pass per OS tick): the last call of every pass, `bsr 0x030546dc` (ui_tick_prescaler_post, void(void)), then `br32 0x03013a56` to the OSFlagPend. -> krk_hook_bg_tick, which makes the stock call first and then runs the monitor (krk_periodic.c, krk_aprsrx.c krk_mon_tick); returns at once unless the Monitor is switched on

splices.name: sq_write_hook
splices.why: F11: hw_register_0x78_write_from_byte_pair (0x0300de78, `movi r0,0x78; or r1,r3; bsr 0x0002c2f4; pop {r15}`) is the single funnel of every stock REG_78H write (channel apply, squelch-menu change, TX end); stock bytes 80 e2 37 f2 = bsr fd6818_reg_write -> bsr krk_hook_sq_write(0x78, word), which passes the write through unchanged (squelch mode Off, digital, level 0) or writes the noise pair instead (docs/noise-squelch.md 6.3); nothing is live after the call but the saved lr that `pop` restores

splices.name: calllog_desc_zh_ptr
splices.why: Call Log sub-list descriptor (category 4), docs/calllog-submenu.md; the arrays are read only through it

splices.name: calllog_gen_render
splices.why: Call Log render case block 0x0303dbf6 (fresh entry, depth 1): menu_option_list_dispatch(5, 0x3e5f8, 0x3e5fa) -> krk_hook_gen (stock generator, then our rows from menu_hosts.json). Void; after it the block reloads r3 and uses nothing else

splices.name: calllog_gen_entry2
splices.why: second Call Log entry path (history push at 0x03036b40, depth 14): same generator call; after it only fresh r2/r3 and calls

splices.name: calllog_gen_entry3
splices.why: third Call Log entry path (rebuilds the list and puts the cursor on item r4): generator(5, r5, r6); after it only r4/r5 (callee-saved) and fresh registers

splices.name: calllog_item_hook
splices.why: Call Log item-action compare chain (0x0303cf80): `bt32 0x0303d872` after `cmpnei r3,3` -> bsr krk_calllog_item_stub (C and r3 live: item 3 -> stock 0x0303cfb6, item 4 -> Last Heard, else the tail). The following `br 0x0303cfb6` becomes dead

splices.name: parrot_tx3
splices.why: IRAM 0x2e9ea: stock `bsr 0x172f8` (copy 27 bytes 0x49b18 -> modem window 0x16000960; r0=0, r1=lrw 0x49b18, r2=27) in the vocoder TX task. LIVE (variant [0x4988a]==0, [0x49888]==1). The bsr is encoded against the IRAM pc (flash + -0x030afc20), hence the +0x30afc20 on the target. Regs: after it only r5/r6/r11 (callee-saved) are used, r2/r3/r12 are reloaded (docs/parrot-tx.md 2.2, re-checked).

splices.name: parrot_tx4
splices.why: IRAM 0x2eaf0: stock `bsr 0x172f8` (copy 27 bytes 0x49b18 -> modem window 0x16000960; r0=0, r1=lrw 0x49b18, r2=27) in the vocoder TX task. LIVE (same variant, other phase). The bsr is encoded against the IRAM pc (flash + -0x030afc20), hence the +0x30afc20 on the target. Regs: after it only r5/r6/r11 (callee-saved) are used, r2/r3/r12 are reloaded (docs/parrot-tx.md 2.2, re-checked).

splices.name: parrot_tx1
splices.why: IRAM 0x2e6c0: stock `bsr 0x172f8` (copy 27 bytes 0x49b18 -> modem window 0x16000960; r0=0, r1=lrw 0x49b18, r2=27) in the vocoder TX task. Dead variant ([0x4988a] has no setter), hooked so a future stock path cannot bypass the layer. The bsr is encoded against the IRAM pc (flash + -0x030afc20), hence the +0x30afc20 on the target. Regs: after it only r5/r6/r11 (callee-saved) are used, r2/r3/r12 are reloaded (docs/parrot-tx.md 2.2, re-checked).

splices.name: parrot_tx2
splices.why: IRAM 0x2e820: stock `bsr 0x172f8` (copy 27 bytes 0x49b18 -> modem window 0x16000960; r0=0, r1=lrw 0x49b18, r2=27) in the vocoder TX task. Dead variant, second phase, hooked for the same reason. The bsr is encoded against the IRAM pc (flash + -0x030afc20), hence the +0x30afc20 on the target. Regs: after it only r5/r6/r11 (callee-saved) are used, r2/r3/r12 are reloaded (docs/parrot-tx.md 2.2, re-checked).

splices.name: parrot_rx
splices.why: IRAM 0x2ed64: stock `bsr 0x172cc` (copy 27 bytes modem window -> 0x46b38; r0=r11=0, r1=lrw 0x46b38, r2=27) in the vocoder RX task (prio 15), the only live read site. krk_vf_rx_hook calls it first, then the RX sink. After the site only r4/r8 (callee-saved) are used and r3/r1/r13 are reloaded. +0x30afc20: IRAM pc encoding.

splices.name: opt_ok_hook
splices.why: OK (second handler 0x0303a770) at a level-2 screen for a category the chain does not know (id >= 10: KRAKEN): stock sets mode 0x1c (`movi r0,28; movi r1,1; bsr 0x03035ec4`, 8 bytes). -> bsr krk_opt_ok, which commits an option row and shows the stock Setting-is-OK popup, else does the stock set-mode itself. The function is a case of a handler whose prologue saved r4/r15 and whose epilogue (0x0303ab4a) pops them (docs/stock-option-level.md 2.5)

splices.name: opt_title_hook
splices.why: title of the level-2 screen (menu_field_value_display_dispatch 0x03038528, case 0x030385c4: category id >= 10 -> `lrw r3,0x030b1458 (empty string); br 0x03038ece` which draws r3 centered in the header) -> bsr krk_title_stub, which loads r3 = krk_opt_title() and jumps to 0x03038ece (docs/stock-option-level.md 2.4)

splices.name: aprs_opt_ok_hook
splices.why: stock APRS (category 9) OK handler 0x0304d6c0, last item test `cmpnei r3,7; bt 0x0304d846` (r3 = level-2 item; items 0..6 were matched above and end in the epilogue) -> bsr krk_aprs_ok_stub: item 7 falls through to the stock block at 0x0304d820, items >= 8 (rows we append, docs/aprs-submenu.md) are committed by krk_aprs_opt_ok when they are option rows (docs/stock-option-level.md 2.6)

splices.name: opt_numtitle_hook
splices.why: header of the stock text-entry screen (subtype 8, edit flag [0x3e31e] bit 6): `lrw r3,0x030ba280; ldr.w r3,(r3,r12<<2)` (the 'Input ID' string of the language) -> bsr krk_numtitle_stub, which returns r3 = krk_num_title() with r0-r2 kept (docs/stock-option-level.md 3.4)

splices.name: rs_desc_zh_ptr
splices.why: Radio Settings sub-list descriptor (Settings category 5, item 0), docs/settings-submenu.md; the arrays are read only through it and by the level-4 header handler, which indexes the same array

splices.name: rs_gen_hook
splices.why: Radio Settings entry block 0x030423a8: menu_option_list_dispatch(20, 0x3e5f8, 0x3e5fa) -> krk_hook_gen (stock generator, then our rows from menu_hosts.json). The only call site of mode 20 in the image; void, and after it the block reloads r3 from a literal

splices.name: rs_item_hook
splices.why: Radio Settings enter chain 0x030431cc: `bt16 0x030432ea; br16 0x030432ac` after `cmpnei r3,3` -> bsr krk_rs_item_stub (C and r3 live: item 3 -> stock 0x030432ac, item 4 -> our row, else the epilogue)

splices.name: settings_opt_ok_hook
splices.why: OK *inside* the option level of a row appended to stock Radio Settings. MEASURED 2026-11-03: opening a row and committing a value are different key events in different functions - the open OK runs 0x0303a770 (category-5 edge 0x0303ab38), the committing OK runs 0x0303a57c -> bsr 0x0304e560 -> jump table 0x030b11c4 entry 0 (Radio Settings) = here. Stock here is a pure no-op (`movi r0,35; movi r1,1; bsr 0x03035ec4` = set_mode(0x23,1), 8 bytes) reached by nothing else: the literal 0x0304e5a0 occurs only in its own table slot, and stock Radio Settings rows commit via 0x0304fab4 instead, so no stock behaviour is lost. Breakpoint-confirmed to fire exactly once, only on the committing OK. The frame (0x0304e560) pushes r15 ONLY, so krk_settings_ok_stub saves r4 itself and jumps to the epilogue 0x0304e83a rather than returning

splices.name: cs_desc_zh_ptr
splices.why: Channel Set sub-list descriptor (Settings category 5, level-2 item 1), docs/chanset-submenu.md. The literal 0x030b89a0 occurs at five sites (0x30387c4, 0x303ba8c, 0x303c1d8, 0x303c3fc, 0x3042534) and every one of them loads the DESCRIPTOR, so editing it in place covers all readers - including the level-4 header handler, which gives the new rows their titles for free

splices.name: cs_desc_zh_count

splices.name: cs_gen_hook
splices.why: Channel Set row generator: menu_option_list_dispatch(6, 0x3e5f8, 0x3e5fa) @0x030493f8 (body menu_option_gen_idx6 @0x03049930, a 21-arm CPS/channel-mode visibility chain) -> krk_hook_gen, which calls the stock generator FIRST so all its gating keeps working and only then appends our rows (menu_hosts.json). This is the MENU-TREE call site; the second mode-6 call at 0x0303e294 belongs to a different wizard that installs cells from descriptor 0x030b8150 (CTC/DCS) and never reads 0x030b89a0, so it is deliberately NOT hooked. Void; after it the block reloads r3

splices.name: cs_item_bound
splices.why: ENTER dispatch bound of table_entry_select_and_index_list_build_toplevel_dispatch @0x03047324: cmphsi r2,22 -> cmphsi r2,31 (raw immediate = value - 1; a 16-bit cmphsi tops out at 32, which tools/gen_menu_hosts.py enforces), so level-3 items 22..30 reach our table entries instead of the out-of-range exit 0x03047cf4. MEASURED in QEMU (docs/nested-submenu.md): this dispatcher is the one the OK on a level-3 row reaches, and it is reached at that depth only

splices.name: cs_item_table_ptr
splices.why: literal-pool word loaded by the lrw at 0x03047338 (the table's sole reference image-wide)

splices.name: cs_ok_bound
splices.why: COMMIT dispatch bound of 0x0304dc8c: cmphsi r3,22 -> cmphsi r3,31 (raw immediate = value - 1). Its out-of-range target 0x0304e416 is NOT an epilogue (it is the stock numeric / Channel-Name path), so a row of ours must never fall out through the bound. MEASURED in QEMU (docs/nested-submenu.md): this is where the OK pressed at any level BELOW a level-3 row arrives, which is also why a nested child list cannot open its own option level from here - docs/nested-submenu.md

splices.name: of_gen_hook
splices.why: Other Func row generator: menu_option_list_dispatch(21, 0x3e5f8, 0x3e5fa) (body 0x03049c00), the only call with mode 21 -> krk_hook_of_gen, which calls the stock generator and then takes item 4 (VOX Delay, now a VOX child) out of the list: on an analog channel item 11 (CW ID) takes its place, elsewhere the rows after it move up

splices.name: of_l6_enter_hook
splices.why: level-6 option init 0x03045fd8 (Settings > Radio Settings > Other Func > row > child): `cmpnei r3,3; bt16 0x03046336` on the level-4 item -> bsr krk_of_l6_enter_stub (r3 = item, lr = 0x03046240 = stock's VOX arm, which reloads r3). The stub returns there for VOX children 0 and 1 and ends at the epilogue 0x03046336 after installing our option level for VOX child 2 and the CW ID children

splices.name: of_l6_ok_hook
splices.why: level-6 commit menu_confirm_apply_dispatcher 0x03050de8: `bt32 0x03051686` after `cmpnei r3,3` on the level-4 item -> bsr krk_of_l6_ok_stub (r3 = item, lr = 0x03051032 = stock's VOX arm). Stock treats every non-zero VOX child as Gain Level, so child 2 MUST be taken here or its cursor would be stored as the gain

splices.name: of_l6_title_hook
splices.why: level-6 header 0x03038b9e: `cmpnei r3,3; bt16 0x03038eb0` (blank) on the level-4 item -> bsr krk_of_l6_title_stub (r3 = item, lr = 0x03038c36 = stock's VOX lookup, which titles child 2 from the relocated array). The CW ID children get their label; everything else the blank string as before

splices.name: vox_sq_read_hook
splices.why: VOX (krk_vox.c): vfo_display_state_nibble_bits_check @0x0300f2a4 (= stock_rx_active) is the ONLY caller of reg_0xc_bit1_read @0x0300eb44, stock's one read of sq_out. In the VOX engine's sense word (txon|micin|afout) that bit reads 1, so stock lit the RX LED, opened audio (an audible tick per window), latched RX-active ~60 s after a hot phase and dropped the UI to its call screen. Stock bytes ff e3 41 fc = bsr reg_0xc_bit1_read -> bsr krk_vox_sq_read, which returns 0 during a sense window and 150 ms after it, else performs the original read (docs/otherfunc-submenu.md).

splices.name: cs_l5_enter_hook
splices.why: Channel Set level-5 init 0x03045084 (render 0x0303cb54 -> 0x0304547c, Settings item 1; docs/chanset-submenu.md 8): `cmphsi r2,13; bt16 0x03045478` on r2 = level-3 row - 3, the bound of its 13-entry table 0x030b09e4 (rows 3..15) -> bsr krk_cs_l5_enter_stub: stock rows return to the table jump at 0x03045098 (r2 kept), every other row runs krk_cs_l5_enter (the Burst Voice children: an option level, or the screen) and leaves through the epilogue 0x03045478. The only branch into the pair is the fall-through; r15 is saved by the prologue (push r4-r7, r15)

splices.name: cs_l5_ok_hook
splices.why: Channel Set level-5 OK 0x030500b0 (0x03036420 -> 0x03050414, Settings item 1): the last test of its compare chain on r3 = level-3 row, `cmpnei r3,15; bt16 0x0305040e` (reached from `cmpnei r3,13; bt 0x0305031a`) -> bsr krk_cs_l5_ok_stub: row 15 returns into stock's arm at 0x0305031e (it reloads r3), every other row runs krk_cs_l5_ok (commit a Burst Voice child) and leaves through the epilogue 0x0305040e. r15 saved by the prologue (push r4, r15)

splices.name: cs_l5_title_hook
splices.why: level-5 header 0x03038994, Channel Set arm 0x03038a7a: `cmpnei r3,15; bt16 0x03038e9c` (blank) on r3 = level-3 row, the only branch to 0x03038e9c (docs/nested-submenu.md 4) -> bsr krk_cs_l5_title_stub: row 15 returns into stock's lookup at 0x03038abc, every other row draws krk_cs_l5_title() through the draw tail 0x03038ece or stock's blank. r15 saved by 0x03038528's prologue (push r4, r15), popped by the tail

splices.name: standby_bottom_hook
splices.why: Standby tags (krk_tags.c, docs/standby-tags.md). standby_screen_refresh_with_statusbar @0x030195cc (push; bsr display_draw_status_bar; bsr standby_screen_refresh; pop), the only path that draws the standby bottom line (boot, Back from a menu, end of a call, popups): `bsr 0x03018e64` (void(void); r0-r3 dead after it, the pop follows) -> krk_hook_standby_bottom, which makes the stock call first and then draws the tags in x 60..199 of rows 290..319

allow_occupied.justification: F9 parrot: five 4-byte bsr splices in the tail of the IRAM load image (flash 0x030bfc20..0x030decb8 is copied verbatim to IRAM 0x10000.. at every boot, docs/parrot-tx.md section 1) redirect the vocoder tasks' modem-window copies (IRAM 0x2e6c0/0x2e820/0x2e9ea/0x2eaf0 write, 0x2ed64 read) to krk_vf_tx_hook/krk_vf_rx_hook. Not the forbidden sector 0x030c6000. Branch targets carry +0x30afc20 because the CPU executes them at the IRAM address.
